item.title: Gunmen kills six in Krakow, three more bodies found at his house
item.description: A chilling new discovery in Poland, where three bodies have reportedly been found inside the Krakow gunman's home. That's in addition to six people killed and sixteen wounded when the attacker opened fire in the city's historic square. Prime Minister Donald Tusk has now declared the shooting an act of terrorism, saying Poland has never experienced anything quite like it. The 25-year-old suspect, described by authorities as holding radical far-right views, was shot by police.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: 'A violent fighter and warrior': Trump offers press secretary role to UFC chief Dana White
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Saturday said he was asking mixed martial arts promoter Dana White to be the new White House press secretary. Trump has repeatedly tried to hitch his MAGA brand of politics to White's enormously successful Ultimate Fighting Championship.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: France Unbowed’s Mélenchon unveils ‘A Shared Future’ manifesto ahead of 2027 presidential race
item.description:
“We are facing a crisis of human civilisation. And we are going to win.”
A defiant Jean-Luc Mélenchon was in fighting mood today as he presented his presidential manifesto at Le Bourget, north of Paris.
It is his fourth bid for the French presidency, and he has chosen a venue steeped in left-wing campaign history: the site of François Hollande's famous 2012 rally.
item.dc:creator: Gavin LEE

item.title: Israeli president picks Netanyahu's rival Eisenkot to try to form government
item.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog picked former military chief Gadi Eisenkot to try to form a government, he said in a statement Saturday. Last month's parliamentary elections left neither Eisenkot nor Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with a clear path to building a majority.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: 'We must change everything': French far-left leader Mélenchon launches presidential programme
item.description: Veteran leftist Jean-Luc Mélenchon formally announced his plan to raise France's minimum wage, cap prices for essential foods and restore the country's retirement age to 60 in a speech launching his 2027 presidential election programme on Saturday. Polls currently indicate that he is the left wing's strongest contender against far-right candidate Marine Le Pen.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: France investigating if bogus bomb threats against airlines linked to 'foreign powers'
item.description: French prosecutors are investigating a series of fake bomb threats that targeted commercial flights in Europe this week, including trying to establish whether foreign powers may be involved. Those responsible for the bogus threats have not been identified.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Paraguay’s impeached president charged over bank collapse
item.description: Paraguay’s impeached president Santiago Pena was on Saturday charged over his business links to a major online bank whose sudden collapse has locked millions of people out of their money and sparked angry protests.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24
